join.description: Joins the bodies of a multi-page chapter, in order.

url.description: Defaults to the URL captured by the table of contents.

all.description: Produce a list of every match instead of the first.
all.title: All

attr.description: 'text', 'html' (inner markup), 'outer_html', or attribute names. A list is tried in order and may mix them.

const.description: A literal. Interpolation still applies, so this produces a value from vars alone when the page does not carry it.

default.description: Used when everything else produced nothing.

fallback.description: Whole alternative Extractors, tried in order while the result is empty. Add a new selector ahead of the old one rather than replacing it.

header.description: A response header, by name, from the response this stage's request produced. Cannot be combined with any other source.

json.description: A dotted path into a JSON body, or into the element css selected. '$' denotes the whole body; segments may be keys or numeric indices.

ItemList.description: A repeated structure: a container, and per-row Extractors evaluated inside it.

fields.description: Per-row Extractors, each evaluated with that row in scope. Extra keys are preserved on the item and readable later as {chapter.<key>}. A field may instead be a URL template referencing earlier siblings as {item.<name>}.
fields.title: Fields

json.description: A dotted path to an array of rows.
json.title: Json

request.description: The request producing the document these rows come from.

reverse.description: Reverse the order, applied after sort_by.
reverse.title: Reverse

sort_by.description: Orders rows by a field, compared numerically. A row whose value is not a number sorts after every row that is.
sort_by.title: Sort By

language.description: A per-novel language, for hosts serving more than one.

request.description: Defaults to a GET of the novel URL.

Paginate.description: How a stage walks more than one page.

concurrent.description: Fetch pages in parallel. Valid only with 'count', since the other conditions cannot know what to request next until the current page is read.
concurrent.title: Concurrent

count.description: Reads the page count from the first page.

limit.description: Caps pages fetched. A truncated result is reported.
limit.title: Limit

next.description: Reads a link to the next page from the current document.

url.description: Produces the second page onward; the first comes from the stage's own request. Required with 'while' and 'count', invalid with 'next'.
url.title: Url

while.description: Stop at the first page yielding nothing. Use when the page count is unknown.
while.title: While

Request.description: Everything about making a request. Reading the response belongs to the stage.

encoding.description: Overrides the spec encoding for this request. Governs the request body as well as the response.
encoding.title: Encoding

form.description: A selector for a form. Its inputs are harvested into payload by name, then payload is applied over the result. With post, the form comes from the document in scope; with get, from the document get fetches, and the request goes to the form's own action.
form.title: Form

from.description: Alternatives tried in order until one yields items.
from.title: From

headers.description: Headers for this request, merged over the spec's own.
headers.title: Headers

name.description: Names this request so 'page' can reference it. Every stage's own request is already named after its stage.
name.title: Name

page.description: Reuse a document already fetched in this operation, by stage name or declared request name.
page.title: Page

paginate.description: How this stage walks more than one page.

payload.description: The request body, valid only with post. Sent as JSON when it holds a nested object, list, boolean or number, and form-encoded otherwise. An explicit content-type header overrides that.
payload.title: Payload

render.description: Run the page's scripts before parsing, for a site whose content is not in the served markup. Far slower than an HTTP fetch.
render.title: Render

wait_for.description: A selector to wait for before reading. Should be set whenever render is.
wait_for.title: Wait For

description: A declarative description of how to read one website, as defined by RFC-0001.

base_url.description: The site's absolute root URL. Its host must match the filename. Absent makes the spec abstract.
base_url.title: Base Url

can_login.description: Derived when absent. false forces an inherited login off; true is rejected unless a login hook resolves.
can_login.title: Can Login

can_search.description: Derived when absent. false forces an inherited search off; true is rejected unless a search stage resolves.
can_search.title: Can Search

chapter.description: How to read one chapter's text.

chapters_per_volume.description: How many chapters make a volume when the site declares none.
chapters_per_volume.title: Chapters Per Volume

disabled.description: Why this host is not served. Present if and only if the document lives in disabled/.
disabled.title: Disabled

encoding.description: A character encoding, for a site that does not declare its own.
encoding.title: Encoding

extends.description: A repository-relative path to one parent spec, in specs/ or base/.
extends.title: Extends

headers.description: Headers for every request. A spec cannot set User-Agent or control header order; those belong to the HTTP layer.
headers.title: Headers

hooks.description: A hook file binding every point it defines, or a mapping of point to file. Points are '<stage>.<field>', '<stage>.request', 'check_response' or 'login'.
hooks.title: Hooks

language.description: An ISO 639-1 two-letter code, used only as a starting default. Detection from the fetched content wins.
language.title: Language

novel.description: How to read a novel's metadata.

parser.description: The markup parser, for a site a lenient parser restructures.
parser.title: Parser

pipes.description: Reusable transform pipes by name, inheritable through extends.
pipes.title: Pipes

rate_limit.description: Requests per second for this host.
rate_limit.title: Rate Limit

search.description: How to search the site. Absent means the source cannot search.

spec.description: The version of the whole contract: this model, the step registry and the hook points. An interpreter refuses a version it does not implement.
spec.title: Spec

toc.description: How to read the chapter list.

vars.description: Named Extractors, read by templates as {vars.<name>}.
vars.title: Vars
